d:
A group of outstanding women from various fields who were on their way to a Women's Convention drowned when the bus they were in crashed into a cabal because the male driver couldn't be trusted to keep two hands on the wheel and two eyes on the road. Among the victims were influencers, youth church leaders, educators, sportswomen and many more. A couple were even pregnant.

None survived.

It was a tragedy that an an event meant to promote women empowerment ended up showing just how vulnerable and helpless they are once they are submerged long enough to cause swollen bellies and foaming mouths and noses. What was worse was that images of them after their drowned bodies were brought on land were leaked to the press a few days later.

I have reproduced them here.
